title: neottia nephrophylla
intro: Neottia nephrophylla, commonly known as the Mountain Cleavers or Western Cleavers, is a rare and endangered orchid species native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Neottia nephrophylla include wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Neottia nephrophylla for medicinal purposes due to its rarity and limited scientific studies.
